tools.name: get_account
tools.description:
Inspect sign-in status, available features and quota reset dates.
require_login=true requests OAuth for an explicit sign-in request.
Guests receive public-modeling limits; private identity requires OAuth.

tools.name: list_public_models
tools.description: Find public Ubi models, scenarios and qualified browser operations without login. Results include next_offset pagination and browser links; this read runs no simulation.

tools.name: get_public_model
tools.description: Read a public model's scenario inputs, units, limitations, source hashes and exact browser qualification. Returns browser_url for qualified no-signup simulation or scans; this read executes no model.

tools.name: get_public_scenario_result
tools.description: Read an already published public scenario result, preserving provenance and warnings. Missing publication is explicitly unavailable, never a new simulation or a zero result. No parameter overrides or server compute.

tools.name: open_research_app
tools.description:
Request the research workspace, optionally focused on a topic or feature.
Returns authorized tools and requests host display; successful rendering
is unverified. Display status is requested, not confirmed open.
